chunks: From him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
"Do not drink the milk of the camels that eat dung (jalalah); if any of their sweat touches you, wash it."

key_terms.الْجَلَّالَةِ: Jalalah (animals that feed on dung/dry fodder)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on drinking milk from camels that eat dung?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the fiqh of *jalalah* by extending the prohibition of their meat to their milk, a ruling derived from the impurity of their diet. It further prescribes washing sweat as a precautionary measure (*ihtiyat*) for ritual purity, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on removing physical impurities (*najāsah*) associated with animals feeding on excrement.
